title: Tradition, Purity, and Compasion for All

questions.question: Why did the Pharisees complain to Jesus about His disciples eating?
options: "They break the tradition of the elders. For they do not wash their hands when they eat."
questions.correctAnswer: "They break the tradition of the elders. For they do not wash their hands when they eat."
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:2 (ESV): "Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat."

questions.question: Jesus counters them by asking why they break the commandment of God for the sake of their tradition. He specifically refers to which commandment?
options: Honor your father and your mother
You shall not bear false witness
questions.correctAnswer: Honor your father and your mother
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:4 (ESV): "For God commanded, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'Whoever reviles father or mother must surely die.'"

questions.question: Jesus accused the Pharisees of saying that whatever might have been used to help their parents was now given to God, thereby making void the word of God. He quoted Isaiah saying: "This people honors me with their lips, but their _____ is far from me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:8 (ESV): "This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me;"

questions.question: According to Jesus speaking to the crowd, what truly defiles a person?
options: What comes out of the mouth, for this proceeds from the heart
What goes into the mouth without washed hands
questions.correctAnswer: What comes out of the mouth, for this proceeds from the heart
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:11 (ESV): "it is not what goes into the mouth that defiles a person, but what comes out of the mouth; this defiles a person."

questions.question: When the disciples informed Jesus that the Pharisees were offended by His saying, how did Jesus refer to the Pharisees?
options: "Let them alone; they are blind guides. And if the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let them alone; they are blind guides. And if the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit."
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:14 (ESV): "Let them alone; they are blind guides. And if the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit."

questions.question: A Canaanite woman came to Jesus crying out for help because her daughter was severely oppressed by a what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:22 (ESV): "...'Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is severely oppressed by a demon.'"

questions.question: When the Canaanite woman first pleaded with Jesus, how did He initially respond?
options: He did not answer her a word
He told her to go in peace
He commanded the demon to leave immediately
questions.correctAnswer: He did not answer her a word
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:23 (ESV): "But he did not answer her a word. And his disciples came and begged him, saying, 'Send her away, for she is crying out after us.'"

questions.question: Jesus told the disciples, "I was sent only to the..." whom?
options: lost sheep of the house of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: lost sheep of the house of Israel
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:24 (ESV): "He answered, 'I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.'"

questions.question: Jesus tested the woman by saying, "It is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the...?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:26 (ESV): "And he answered, 'It is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.'"

questions.question: How did the Canaanite woman reply to Jesus' statement about the dogs?
options: "Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."
"No, Lord, for I have prepared a feast for you."
"Then I will find another to heal her."
"The dogs should be cast out entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:27 (ESV): "She said, 'Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table.'"

questions.question: What did Jesus commend the Canaanite woman for when He healed her daughter?
options: "O woman, great is your faith! Be it done for you as you desire."
"O woman, your humility has saved you!"
"Because you are a Gentile, you are blessed."
questions.correctAnswer: "O woman, great is your faith! Be it done for you as you desire."
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:28 (ESV): "Then Jesus answered her, 'O woman, great is your faith! Be it done for you as you desire.' And her daughter was healed instantly."

questions.question: Later, climbing a mountain beside the Sea of Galilee, Jesus healed many, meaning the crowd glorified the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:31 (ESV): "...and they glorified the God of Israel."

questions.question: How many days had the crowd been with Jesus before He determined to feed them so they would not faint on the way?
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:32 (ESV): "Then Jesus called his disciples to him and said, 'I have compassion on the crowd because they have been with me now three days and have nothing to eat...'"

questions.question: In the feeding of the four thousand, how many loaves and fish did the disciples start with?
options: Seven loaves and a few small fish
Three loaves and a salted fish
questions.correctAnswer: Seven loaves and a few small fish
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:34 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'How many loaves do you have?' They said, 'Seven, and a few small fish.'"

questions.question: In the feeding of the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces were taken up?
questions.explanation: Matthew 15:37 (ESV): "And they all ate and were satisfied. And they took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces left over."

key_verse_text: "it is not what goes into the mouth that defiles a person, but what comes out of the mouth; this defiles a person."
